parameters.command:
=IDS="{{ $input.all().filter(i => i.json.videoId).map(i => i.json.videoId).join(' ') }}"
echo "$IDS" | tr ' ' '\n' | xargs -P4 -I{} sh -c 'yt-dlp --skip-download --write-auto-sub --write-sub --sub-langs en --sub-format vtt -o "/tmp/yt-{}" "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={}" >/tmp/yt-{}.log 2>&1'
for id in $IDS; do
  echo "===VIDEO:$id==="
  cat /tmp/yt-$id*.vtt 2>/dev/null
  echo "===FIM==="
done
rm -f /tmp/yt-*
